name.baseName: Sugar beets IP, crown and leaf harvested, at farm

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: This dataset represents the cultivation of sugar beet on 1 ha. Sugar beet roots and sugar beet crown and leaf are both harvested. The yield of sugar beet root is 77640 kg/ha at a moisture content at storage of 77%, the yield of sugar beet crown and leaf is 51760 kg/ha at a moisture content of 86%.; UUID: c7d4dd17-5a47-38a6-8cb8-67cc089fb6ec

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: The yield data have been updated to an average of the years 2000, 2005 & 2008. (Schweizerischer Bauernverband: Statistische Erhebungen und Schätzungen über Landwirtschaft und Ernährung 2009)

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Swiss integrated production (SIP)

# Included processes
This activity starts after the harvest of the previous crop. The inputs of seeds, mineral fertilisers and pesticides are considered. Farm manure as an organic fertiliser is only accounted for in terms of direct field emissions; all pre-processes are included in the animal production systems. The transport of seeds, pesticides and fertilisers from the regional storehouse to the farm is also included. The dataset includes all machine operations and corresponding machine infrastructure and sheds. Machine operations are: soil cultivation, sowing, fertilisation, weed control, pest management, harvest and transport from field to farm (1 km). Further, direct field emissions are included. The cultivation of green manure during winter before sowing beets is also included. This activity ends after harvest at the farm gate.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Data were compiled from statistics, pilot network, fertilising recommendations, documents from extension services, information provided by retailers and expert knowledge. The production data were verified and adjusted by a group of experts.
